scope: Broaden primary-source research on independent open-source ACIS stream readers and GDAL DXF/DWG routes; refine the existing optional composed evidence checkpoint without adding routine work, fixtures, dependencies, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of versioned crate documentation, source repository documentation, and current GDAL driver documentation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing CADMPEG/acis-core cross-read boundary, GDAL raw-ASM lane, optional composed comparator cadence, and six external-only J gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing libopencad lineage and GDAL CAD versus ODA DWG distinction
method.limitations: Published docs and manifests establish declared route scope, not a locally reproduced parser result, exact source/artifact correspondence, complete source-independence audit, or native semantic acceptance. The CADMPEG 0.6.1 runtime and GDAL options were not executed.

routeFindings.observed: The versioned crate describes a read-only parser for bare ShapeManager/ASM SAT/SAB streams and ACIS binary save formats 217/218. It documents ASM BinaryFile4 and BinaryFile8 framing, text ASM/ACIS termination, declared solved-record limits, explicit decode losses, unknown-record retention/source spans where available, and blocking geometry-not-transferred outcomes. It does not parse DWG/DXF containers or AcDs ownership. Rust 1.88+ is required.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: Conditional exact-profile inner-stream parser candidate; release documentation only. No result qualifies until source/package provenance, source overlap, exact profile compatibility, and execution are checked. It is not a DWG/DXF codec, writer, or native consumer.
routeFindings.planUse: At most one optional run at the already-planned composed checkpoint. Pin crate archive/hash, source commit and Cargo lock/toolchain; audit overlap with acis-core/cq-acis; verify stream kind, version, reference width, losses, body disposition, unknown records, and independent analytic expectations.

routeFindings.observed: Current docs say Binary DXF reading starts at GDAL 3.12; EntityHandle is exposed; RawCodeValues is opt-in and includes only unhandled codes. Disabling inline blocks exposes block, insertion, scale, angle, OCS, and attribute fields. On AC1027+ with DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE enabled, the driver exposes raw ASM bytes and a 12-value transform but does not create OGR solid geometry. The writer targets AC2004 and projections/tessellations are intentionally lossy for many entity families.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: Optional DXF structural/projection/carrier comparator only. Raw-code capture is incomplete by design; ASM bytes do not establish ACIS semantics, B-rep closure, or DWG AcDs association.
routeFindings.planUse: Pin release/build and input mode. Use direct reader output, opt into raw-code values, disable inline/merge for block tests, and enable raw ASM mode only for AC1027+. Record entity handle/owner/placement, raw carrier, projection, unknown/skipped disposition, and diagnostics separately.

routeFindings.observed: GDAL's CAD driver is based on libopencad and is documented as read-only with a narrow projected entity set. GDAL's separate DWG driver requires ODA Teigha. The driver name therefore identifies materially different parser and licensing routes.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: CAD belongs to the existing libopencad lineage; DWG/ODA is a separately licensed external route. Neither OGR projection exposes a complete DWG owner graph or ACIS/AcDs solid semantics.
routeFindings.planUse: Record the exact GDAL driver, backend/library revision, build configuration, version, and options. Do not count a generic GDAL result as a new parser vote or open-source route without backend attribution.

ownersRefined: optional independent ACIS inner-stream cross-read and semantic metrics
GDAL CAD/libopencad versus DWG/ODA backend attribution
outer DWG AcDs owner closure and native consumer gates remain separate
